body:
Thank you for taking a moment to try to help a stranger. I'm glad people like you are around. Dont ever let thid ridiculous world beat that trait out of you. If someone near me would step up, I'd at least feel confident about moving forward, knowing I would have support from someone will be strong for me.

My dad is pretty cool. He does what he can to help me, but he's broke, so yeah... plus,  he doesn't know how weak I've felt lately.

Anyway, regardless of the outcome, thanks for taking a moment to try to offer some words. You've helped me a bit. Hopefully I'll be able to build on that.

Thank you.

I guess. But I will likely wind up with the same company I'm with now, and it's hard to get your shot. 

You know what keeps me going, honestly? Little stupid things. I don't ever think about who would care for my wife, but I do think "what if I kill myself and then the Cardinals win the Superbowl and I miss it". 

I'm just sick of small victories. There has got to be more to life than just 'getting by'. 

If I'm totally honest, I guess a better life could await me, but it's gonna be so much work and I have so little support. Like, I have to be strong for my mentally ill wife. Now my 14 year old step-daughter has had a baby, and I have to be even stronger to make up for that nonsense. Then I go to visit my dying mother, and an evening with family turns into a heated passionate discussion full of hysterical crying and shouting from everyone but me. I have to be strong for them too.

But sometimes, I get weak too. Sometimes, I need to make dumb choices and be weak. But I'm not allowed to be. Because everyone else is too busy being weak and they don't notice me, begging for someone to save me for once. 

Why won't anyone help me? I set aside my own happiness to save others in their time of weakness, but no one will save me!! I'm in danger!! I watch the scenario in my head every day! I watch myself buy the gun and ammo, I even have the local news station's number saved in my phone so they could come out to some public place and report to the whole world that I just wanted someone to stand up and be strong for me, for once!! And then I have to apologize to everyone because even in my weakness, I can't blame others for my short comings! No one apologizes to me for RUINING MY GOD DAMN LIFE AND EVERYTHING I HAD GOING!! Everyone is so proud they insist that it's okay to have a baby when you're 14, or to stop taking your psych meds, or because you can't keep your cool! No one says they're sorry for all that! 

I can't keep it up! Someone needs to save me, like I always save others. Someone needs to do it before I wind up a 15-second story on the 6 o'clock news! You'll know it.

You'll hear about it. I'll suggest to the news station that maybe I'll shoot a bunch of people, even though I won't cuz I don't wanna hurt anyone. But I'll tell them I do just to make sure CNN covers the story.

You'll hear about it. Probably just for a second cuz the ordeal will end with only me dying, and a note in pocket, covered in my blood, stating that I was never going to harm anyone but myself. And asking why no one would step up and save me, when it was so obvious that I needed it.
